svg.text: CNC cassette plate replacing the Penguin XL rear-lid section — hangs two D1 coils in the 7 gal glycol tank (2 active stations + 1 capped spare) · all dims mm
PLAN — CASSETTE PLATE, VIEW FROM ABOVE
FIT TO PENGUIN REAR-LID APERTURE — obtain lid drawing from Penguin, VERIFY #3.
Edge dims are placeholders (A) until the aperture is confirmed — see PARAMETERS box.
2 × Ø4.9 THRU per station, 30 apart — 3/16 in food-grade compression bulkhead
glands (Swagelok SS-300-61 class): INLET stub + OUTLET pass-through
coil hanger — 2 × Ø6 316 standoff rods + saddle clamp on the coil top turn
T4 bath-RTD gland — 1/8 in compression bulkhead, near plate center
circulator bracket (bayite BYT-7A015 class) + Ø8 cable gland
Ø50 glycol top-up port with snap cap
lifting handle — folded 316 strip, 100 span (2 ×, short edges), rated 15 kg
perimeter gasket groove 6 wide × 3 deep, underside — food-grade cord
station 3 spare — blanking plugs in both glands (shipped plugged)
1. Plate: food-safe HDPE, 25 thick (alt: 316 × 5 with stiffeners — re-gasket to suit).
2. Deburr and break all edges; no sharp corners at handle mounts.
3. Plate and coils must NOT bear on the tank evaporator — check clearances against
the Penguin lid/tank drawing (VERIFY #3) before machining.
4. Leak-check each gland at 300 kPa with its coil fitted, before first glycol fill.
5. Lifting handles rated 15 kg each — plate + two coils + wetted glycol.
6. Station 3 is a capped spare — shipped with blanking plugs fitted.
7. Gasket: food-grade cord, seated in the 6 × 3 perimeter groove (underside).
SECTION A-A — THROUGH ONE COIL STATION
cut at station 2 (stations identical; station 3 carries blanking plugs) — coil per DWG D1
through its gland to the INVERTED-U;
40 mm above glycol level; then turns
tank floor / evaporator below — plate & coil must NOT bear on it (note 3)
plate seats on food-grade gasket cord (6 × 3 groove, key 7) on the tank rim;
glands bulkhead-sealed — leak-check each station 300 kPa with coil fitted (note 4)
A = aperture L × W per Penguin lid dwg
are placeholders until A is confirmed
